correctness.rationale: The primary equations give \(F_u+F_c=F\) and the stated zero-food point has \(F_u'=p_fF\), so it is not an equilibrium for \(F>0\). On the invariant food-total manifold the clean-food equilibrium is exact. Its \(3\times3\) infected/environmental characteristic polynomial is reconstructed explicitly; for \(q>0\), \(\mathcal R_F<1\) implies all cubic Routh–Hurwitz inequalities, while \(\mathcal R_F>1\) makes the constant term negative and hence forces a positive real eigenvalue. The equality case is left nonhyperbolic and unclassified. The rational witness is checked by the packaged verifier.

value.rationale: The issue changes the model's disease-free equilibrium and the local invasion threshold at the center of Proposition 4.1. The missing feedback can reverse a stability conclusion even with strictly positive rational parameters, so the correction is structural rather than cosmetic. It also identifies the exact food-reservoir amplification factor and a parameter regime in which the published \(\mathcal R_0^L\) is insufficient.
